MSc Computer Science

The Master of Science in Computer Science is a two-year programme taught entirely in English at the Example University Faculty of Engineering. The programme covers advanced algorithms, machine learning, distributed systems, and software engineering with a research thesis in the final semester. Applicants must hold a bachelor degree in computer science or a closely related field such as software engineering or information technology.

Tuition and funding

Tuition fees for non-EU students are EUR 2,000 per year. Several departmental scholarships cover full tuition and include a monthly stipend of EUR 800 for the top admitted candidates.

English requirements

IELTS 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0 is required. A Medium of Instruction letter from the applicant's bachelor institution may be accepted as an alternative proof of proficiency, subject to verification by the admissions board.
